description: This is a JUnit test class for the SnapshotStreamingActor in the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests streaming snapshots from a MongoDB collection using Akka Streams, with mock dependencies to verify behavior with empty and non-empty collections.

classes.name: SnapshotStreamingActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for SnapshotStreamingActor. Sets up an ActorSystem, mocks dependencies, and tests snapshot streaming with empty and non-empty data.

methods.name: initActorSystem
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem and mocks before each test.

methods.name: shutdownActorSystem
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: streamEmptySnapshotCollection
methods.description: Test case for streaming when the snapshot collection is empty.

methods.name: streamNonemptySnapshotCollection
methods.description: Test case for streaming when the snapshot collection contains documents.

methods.name: setSnapshotStore
methods.description: Mocks the getNewestSnapshotsAbove method to return a specified source of Documents.

methods.name: createSnapshotStreamingActor
methods.description: Creates an ActorRef for the SnapshotStreamingActor with test props.
